Name: (CP and AT) Aymeric Spouse Portrait Slightly Cuter Style for the Traveling Cart
Author: octopathtraversing
Description:
[b][u]Summary:

[/u][/b]"What initially started as a joke or mere assets with no clue how to mod them in turned into a full mod. Now Aymeric too can have the ignominy of having the traveling merchant sell his spouse portrait just like the other singles!


How quaint.


The traveling merchant has many portraits of him available, but no one's sure how they wind up in the inventory. 

Maybe it's the long string of connections that allow for so much surprising merchandise.

It's also rumored there's potential blackmail within the inventory, but it seems unless you find the backdoor, it won't be available to you right now. It's ok, it's good for his heart the retired Lord Speaker doesn't see it at all."




The Content Patcher [CP] mod is required as the base for the Alternative Textures [AT] mod to expand upon his spouse portraits. Make sure to download the [CP] mod and extract it into your mods folder for Stardew Valley before adding in the [AT] mod.

[u]Pathway should be as such, at least for windows if you're using the Steam client:[/u] PC/Local Disk(C:)/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods

The Alternative Textures [AT] mod follows the same instructions. Download it, then extract it to your mods folder for Stardew Valley.




[b][u]
Credits:

[/u][/b]Permission was obtained by Adaire99 for uploading this mod.
Major credits to Poltergeister for the Slightly Cuter Aymeric sprite bases used to make these portraits.
Spouse Portraits themselves are done by me.
[b][u]
Known Issue:

[/u][/b]Aymeric's portrait may or may not also show up in the furniture catalogue as it had in my current save despite setting the code to true so it would not show up. I have no clue if a fresh save will remove it from the catalogue, but keep that in mind.
